protocol.source_access: Only mobile-playtest.mjs --help read; no game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings or hidden state inspected. Own generated evidence/report only.
protocol.fresh_lifecycle: Attempt 1 act tap #deploy + capture. Attempt 2 act tap #play-again + capture after first terminal stats saved. No retry or third attempt.
protocol.observation: Every returned screenshot viewed in separate tool call before dependent input. One new scene target per batch. Waits <=3000ms; actual shortened waits inspected in timings.
protocol.menus: No map, KIT or settings opened; no settings changed.

learning_between_attempts: Opening AIM burst in attempt 1 had no target and reported NO IMPACT; attempt 2 applied tap aim to visible opening guard then zoomed burst, confirmed TARGET DOWN.
Tap aim and anchored fire were easier to direct than simultaneous manual MOVE/FIRE drag; even a smaller second drag still required retarget.
Learned visible route/approach and coil/deck flow from attempt 1. Later completion remains assisted and cannot certify manual traversal or combat comfort.

helpful_moments.moment: Opening instruction names tap aim, FIRE, swipe and DASH; opening guard down confirmation was immediate and readable.
TURN FIRE LEFT revealed patrol; fresh retarget produced clear SENTINEL DOWN feedback.
Recovery checkmarks, individual coil OFF meters, automatic reload and upload percentage kept objectives understandable.
Zoomed guard kill and explicit assisted statistics at terminal distinguish assist use.

frustrating_moments.moment: FIRE drag shifted aim away during patrol engagement; needed a new target tap.
Manual drag still changed heading substantially and left target alive; successful correction relied on tap aim.
Zoomed empty-scene burst wasted six rounds (NO IMPACT); my input error retained.
Rear threats and small world labels were harder to interpret than large overlay cues. Empty magazine interrupted coil damage.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed content. Holistic judgment, not outcome-derived or arithmetic average; no desired score.

reasons.overall_mobile: Clear objective progression and attractive coherent station presentation, with reliable visible assist completion across two runs. Repeated manual aim corrections limit confidence in mobile combat comfort.
reasons.controls: Large labeled controls and tap aim helped. Two-contact patrol drag needed correction in both attempts. DASH activation/cooldown observed, effective evade not proven. Zoom works, but sustained rearming cannot be judged.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, timed coil vulnerability, reload pressure and deck hold supplied distinct observable tasks. Assisted route reduced navigation effort. Two wins do not establish difficulty balance or uninterrupted enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rainy station, teal/orange feedback, gun view, environmental names and recovery result gave a coherent visual identity. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach labels, directional threat prompts, phase labels, auto reload and transparent assist counts were useful. Untreated rear enemies created pressure while focus stayed on coils.
reasons.readability: Objective, health/ammo, target feedback and results were legible at 844x390. World signage and distant enemies were much smaller and lower contrast; overlays occupy appreciable scene space.
